name: garmin-claude-mcp
description: Connect Garmin training data to Claude and push workouts back to your watch

INTERVALS_API_KEY.description: Your intervals.icu API key. Settings > Developer Settings.

INTERVALS_ATHLETE_ID.description: Your intervals.icu athlete id, the iNNNNNN in your profile URL.

MCP_PASSWORD.description: Password you will type when connecting Claude. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
